composition.currentLayout: HostOrganizersScreen resolves auth and host club streams, HostOrganizersScaffold owns selected-club and tab state, HostOrganizerEditBody composes Media, Identity, Contact, and Club settings, and four top-level spoke screens own Event defaults, Live event guide, Host team, and owner-only Payments. HostOrganizerDefaultsSaver serializes optimistic defaults mutations.
composition.targetLayout: Keep Host Clubs as a thin route adapter over provider-free tab and spoke sections, with repository writes owned by controllers and one canonical CatchSection/CatchField composition per concern.

sections.name: Host clubs route state adapter
sections.migration: HostOrganizersScreenState owns selected-club, tab, and owner/co-host role capability display state; HostOrganizersScaffold owns the embedded public-preview composition. Continue extracting retry intents, inline edit patches, and mutation state into testable adapters.

sections.migration: HostOrganizersScreenState owns the selected club and picker visibility while HostOrganizersScaffold composes the shared CatchRootScreenScaffold.withPrimaryRail with settings and club-switcher actions.

sections.name: Host clubs tab rail
sections.migration: Keep Edit as the default route tab and selection as screen state. Loaded and route-level loading, auth, error, and empty branches retain the same pinned Edit, Insights, and Preview rail through CatchRootScreenScaffold.withPrimaryRail and the shared CatchPageTabBar primitive.

sections.name: Host club Edit tab
sections.migration: Edit now owns exactly Media, Identity, Contact, and Club settings. Defaults, payments, and team content moved to dedicated top-level spokes; profile/public preview remains owned by Preview.

sections.name: Host club form rows
sections.migration: Completed: Identity and Contact use typed form descriptors and one Host-owned save delegate; the private HostInline editor family is deleted.

sections.name: Host club event defaults editor
sections.migration: Activity and booking-policy defaults share one spoke and one serialized functional update seam; numeric fields use field-local explicit actions while switches commit immediately.

sections.name: Host club payout setup card
sections.targetOwner: provider-free payout section plus payment controller adapter
sections.migration: Completed: provider-neutral account presentation and controller seams expose Razorpay Route and Stripe setup/refresh independently; country-derived recommendation changes ordering without hiding either provider.

sections.name: Host club team management section
sections.targetOwner: single Host team workspace plus provider-free team section and HostTeamManagementController
sections.migration: HostOrganizerTeamScreen is the single route owner for profile Edit / Preview, selected-club team management, hosted-club navigation, and Edit-only bottom sign out. Host-team writes remain in HostTeamManagementController.

sections.name: Host club insights pane
sections.migration: Complete (P3.5). HostInsightsScreen keeps the period and resolves the selected organizer; hostInsightsController reads the cached host report (day bars over seven days, week bars otherwise) through the device IANA timezone; HostInsightsBody and HostInsightsState are provider-free. Captures and body render tests cover it, with no Widgetbook case.

sections.name: Host club preview pane
sections.migration: HostOrganizersScaffold composes the same OrganizerDetailReadOnlyPreview used by the public club-detail surface so preview rendering has one canonical owner.

sections.targetOwner: canonical Organizer state shell plus shared sliver empty state

sections.name: Host clubs access loading and error states
sections.migration: Retry and sign-in navigation intents stay in HostOrganizersScreen while HostOrganizerStateScaffold owns the provider-free title, pinned rail, body rhythm, and terminal clearance shared by access, loading, error, and offline branches.

sections.name: Host team route adapter
sections.migration: Profile/clubs waves, fallback derivation, tab/account action availability, and club navigation policy now route through HostTeamWorkspaceState, while profile create/save mutations route through HostProfileController. Payout/admin ownership is blocked on product IA; reference-backed comparison is tracked by DS-HOST-SETTINGS-004.

sections.targetOwner: route-owned top bar with shared tab rail
sections.migration: Host team tab rail uses shared CatchPageTabBar, and the pushed route uses explicit CatchLegacyTopBar back navigation enforced by screen_top_bar_contracts.json. Remaining work is deciding whether tab/action state belongs in HostTeamWorkspaceState or stays route-local until broader account-action policy is settled.

sections.name: Host team profile summary
sections.migration: HostTeamProfileSection is provider-free and renders no-profile, fallback, active, preview, and status rows from HostTeamProfileState plus callbacks. Fallback derivation now lives in HostTeamWorkspaceState and profile create/save mutations route through HostProfileController.

sections.migration: HostTeamProfileList renders display name, role title, status, and bio inside one CatchSection.fieldRows form and exposes the save mutation inline; captures cover ready, pending, failed, and offline save states.

sections.migration: HostTeamHostedOrganizersSection is provider-free and renders loading, error, empty, edit, and preview rows from explicit club state and callbacks. Remaining adapter work is typed route-intent display data shared with Host Clubs where useful.

openGaps.nextAction: Signed-out, default organizer overview, co-host, empty, loading, generic/offline load errors, analytics loading/error/offline/report, payout provider loading/ready/restricted/error/offline, inline editor pending/error/offline, payout action pending/error/offline, host-team mutation pending/error/offline, text-scale, reduced-motion, light/dark, insights report, and preview tab variants are captured. Additional pixel variants depend on future Claude exports because the local bundle exposes only the organizer baseline for this screen.

Selected club, selected tab, and owner/co-host role capability live in HostOrganizersScreenState. The organizer Edit tab is the only club editor and owns identity, contact, logo/photos, policy defaults, Event Success defaults, payouts, and host team. The former /host/clubs/:organizerId/edit location is not mounted. Inline edit, media, defaults, and payout actions have controller mutations; Host Team sheet/dialog states are public; HostOrganizerInsightsState owns analytics query and retry target identity. Broader provider-free section extraction remains part of GOAL-DS-002.

Widgetbook now covers Host Clubs route states, organizer overview, tab rail, profile editor, inline editors, payout card, host team, analytics, preview, and access/loading/error sections. Continue adding reference-specific variants only when exported designs require them.

HOST-STANDALONE-ORGANIZER-WORKSPACE-001 bounds the 2026-08-10 standalone workspace at 20.09% mismatch / 25.94 meanDelta while preserving the canonical threshold. Replace or reconcile the older organizer reference with a reviewed standalone-host composition before removing the ceiling; extra cohost, empty, loading/error/offline, analytics, payout, inline editor, team mutation, text-scale, reduced-motion, and light/dark comparisons still depend on future design exports.

Close feature.host_organizers evidence exceptions with focused tests for the registered route, settings, analytics, payout, profile, team, accessibility, and theme states; deterministic captures for the 14 preview-only states; and a dedicated Widgetbook scenario for host_team_offline.
